01 / Profile

About Me

Lovely Professional University, Punjab

An MBA candidate in Financial Consulting & Operations Management, drawn to the discipline of turning raw numbers into a decision someone can act on.

My work sits at the intersection of financial modeling and strategic consulting — building 3-statement models, DCF and LBO valuations, and forecasts that hold up under scrutiny. Alongside a Finance & Marketing internship at Impactra Consulting, I've built live models spanning project finance, M&A and applied research, while developing the communication and stakeholder-management skills consulting work demands.

Before the MBA, I completed a Bachelor of Commerce (Business Administration) at Ahmednagar College with a CGPA of 8.82, following my schooling at Kendriya Vidyalaya No.2 MIRC.
